# Two edits in one file of the NASDAQ:AMZN price, each stating its guid and a
# different value.
#
# Applied in turn, the second would win, so the order of the blocks would decide
# the value.
#
# What this fixture produces, on a book holding
# prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt: nothing; both blocks are refused, and
# the price keeps 218.45.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_one_guid_stated_in_two_price_blocks_is_refused.py.
price
	guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
	value: "21900/100"

price
	guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
	value: "22000/100"
